title: Breadcrumbs with separators
summary: A flex row with gap, where the separator is its own item so spacing stays even.
explanation: Each crumb and each separator is a flex item, and gap puts the same space between every pair. Using a separator element, rather than a margin, keeps the spacing consistent when the crumbs change length.
align-items: center keeps the separators level with the text, even when a crumb is styled bigger. flex-shrink: 0 on the current page stops it squashing when the trail is long.
tryThis: Change align-items to flex-start: the separators sit higher than the text.
Make the last crumb longer and narrow the preview: the earlier crumbs shrink, while the current page keeps its width.
Set gap to 0 and watch the separators butt against the words.
